summary: Expose the read-only lookup HTTP API
description: Add a versioned, rate-limit-ready HTTP adapter over the shared lookup service.
acceptance: R-1: HTTP responses validate against the same lookup-result schema used by CLI and MCP.
R-2: Lookup telemetry is separable, minimizable, and incapable of changing reputation.

review_history.evidence: Acceptance R-1/R-2 verified: canonical schema and shared-result parity pass; telemetry minimization, failure isolation, rate gate, error, method, health, and no-store boundaries have integration proof.
